create_utterance_with_word_timestamps: create an Utterance dataclass instance with words, start times, and end times for prosody analysis
serialize_deserialize_utterance: serialize an Utterance to JSON string and deserialize it back to an Utterance instance
compute_aligner_based_pause_lengths: compute pause lengths between consecutive words using word start and end timestamps
